name: Evil Eye of Gorgoneio
card_text: Equip only to an "Evil Eye" monster. You can only activate 1 "Evil Eye of Gorgoneio" per turn. This card's name becomes "Evil Eye of Selene" while in the Spell & Trap Zone. While your LP are lower than your opponent's, the equipped monster gains ATK equal to the difference. You can banish this card from your GY and discard 1 "Evil Eye" card; add 1 "Evil Eye" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, except "Evil Eye of Gorgoneio". You can only use this effect of "Evil Eye of Gorgoneio" once per turn.
